lines: This plan covers 3 days, starting Thursday 2026-09-10.
Shopping and cooking first thing in the morning, so it is ready by lunch.
Shopping happens 2 times: Thursday and Friday. The later trips are there so fresh food does not wait for the pan.
Part of what is cooked on Saturday is bought close to that day: fresh food from the first shop would not keep that long.
The chicken batch is used in bowls, wraps and salad so the short cooking sessions still give you varied meals.
The spare Saturday lentil and salmon portions are frozen on the cooking day rather than kept in the fridge beyond their safe window.
